item.mod-stella-tower.floor_key.desc: Carried into the tower, the highest key takes you to its floor. It is never spent.
item.mod-stella-tower.void_key.desc: Returns you to where you entered the tower.
message.mod-stella-tower.void_key.outsid: The Void Key only works inside the tower.
message.mod-stella-tower.void_key.no_ent: The Void Key does not remember where you came from.

item.mod-stella-tower.wisp.rage: Mobs standing on the lit way are enraged
message.mod-stella-tower.wisp.lit: The wisp lights the way to the portal: %s steps
message.mod-stella-tower.wisp.nowhere: The wisp finds no portal to lead you to here
